title: Glow Nightime Pedal Boat Rental in San Diego Bay
includes: Adults, kids and dogs life jackets
USD 5 Pet Clean Up fee will be charged at location (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Not recommended for travelers with knees problems
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
- Breathtaking views of the San Diego Downtown at night.

- Maximum capacity per boat Up to 3 adults and 1 small child (around 4–5 years old ), or 2 adults and 2 children. Maximum combined weight: 600 lbs. Maximum recommended weight per seat: 230 lbs. Children under 4 are welcome as long as they can safely wear one of our provided U.S. Coast Guard-approved life jackets and are supervised by an adult.

- Our Pedal Boats are equipped with very comfortable seating. 

- We provide blankets by request

* Well-behaved dogs are welcome. Great combinations will be:
- 2 adults group: up to 2 large dogs, 3 medium dogs, or 4 small dogs.
- 3 adults group: up to 1 large dog, 2 medium dogs, or 3 small dogs.
Dog life jackets are provided.
